source: Seeded random legal games generated with chess.js 1.4.0; no pretrained weights, human games or engine
familySplit: Whole games 0-23 train, 24-31 validation, 32-39 test; parent and child position keys deduplicated across all splits

targetDefinitions.white_material_balance_div16: White minus black material with P=1 N=B=3 R=5 Q=9 K=0, divided by 16
targetDefinitions.side_to_move_best_capture_after_recaptur: Best nonnegative immediate capture material gain after worst legal immediate recapture onto the destination square, signed to white perspective and divided by 9

limitations: Random-play distribution, not representative skilled chess
No mate search or full tactical evaluation
Within-pair positions are related and must not be treated as independent observations
The starting position occurs only in training after global deduplication
New split results are not directly comparable with pilot-v1 losses
